title: GP - Better item transaction duplicate handling
summary: Fixes duplicate records during GP migration when inventory transactions contain multiple lot number receipt lines. A new GP item transactions buffer table is added and the GP Populate Combined Tables logic is updated, with permission set updates and new tests.
key_points: New GP Item Transactions Buffer table added to the HybridGP app
GP Populate Combined Tables codeunit updated to avoid duplicate item transactions
Duplicates happened when a transaction had several lot number receipt lines
HybridGP permission sets and permission set extensions updated for the new table
New tests added in GP Item Transaction Tests
quote: fixes a duplicate issue that occurs when a GP migration client is migrating inventory transactions that contain multiple lot number receipt lines
